description: Cross-POM pin alignment. The four service POMs are standalone by design (ADR-17 §3.5); Renovate opens one PR per dependency and updates every pom.xml that declares it, so pins stay aligned on upgrade. scripts/check-pin-drift.py (ci.yml pin-drift job) is the enforcement backstop for manual edits.

packageRules.description: Batch patch+minor into one weekly PR — one-operator review load
Majors stay individual PRs — Boot/Spring AI bumps need the repo's verify-before-build pass
